diff --git a/mail/components/customizableui/content/panelUI.js b/mail/components/customizableui/content/panelUI.js

--- a/mail/components/customizableui/content/panelUI.js

@@ -33,6 +33,8 @@ ChromeUtils.defineESModuleGetters(this, {

   ExtensionsUI: "resource:///modules/ExtensionsUI.sys.mjs",

+++ b/mail/test/browser/shared-modules/WindowHelpers.sys.mjs
@@ -291,11 +291,13 @@ async function _click_appmenu_in_sequence(navTargets, nonNavTarget, win) {
 
       const foundNode = kids.find(findFunction);
 
-      EventUtils.synthesizeMouseAtCenter(
-        foundNode,
-        {},
-        foundNode.documentGlobal

+        EventUtils.synthesizeMouseAtCenter(
+          foundNode,
+          {},
+          foundNode.documentGlobal
+        );
+      }
     }
 
     // We are all done when there are no more navigation targets.
